title: Oozy Mediterranean Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A fermented and silky lamb dish featuring passata and bhuna, perfect for a lazy Sunday, served in a scallop shell vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the passata, bhuna spice mix, dried apricots, and prunes, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine in scallop shell vessels, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
